sources.title: Halberd Mills: a cooperative that outlasted the trade
Cooperative register: Halberd Mills, filing summary
The secretary's view: two decades of Cawden Vale weaving

claims.text: Halberd Mills Cooperative was founded in 1998 by a group of hand-weavers in Cawden Vale.

citations.quote: Halberd Mills Cooperative was founded in 1998 by a group of hand-weavers in Cawden Vale

claims.text: Halberd Mills Cooperative was incorporated in the spring of 1997 and remains registered at its original address in Cawden Vale.

citations.quote: Halberd Mills Cooperative was incorporated in the spring of 1997 and remains registered at its original address in Cawden Vale

claims.text: The cooperative began trading in 1999, in a converted grain store in Cawden Vale.

citations.quote: The cooperative began trading in 1999, in a converted grain store in Cawden Vale

claims.text: Halberd Mills Cooperative has produced wool blankets there ever since.

citations.quote: it has produced wool blankets there ever since

claims.text: The cooperative's principal activity is the manufacture of wool blankets and throws.

citations.quote: Principal activity: manufacture of wool blankets and throws

claims.text: Everything it sells is a wool blanket of one kind or another.

citations.quote: Everything it sells is a wool blanket of one kind or another

claims.text: The cooperative has never made anything but blankets: plain, ridge, and check.

citations.quote: we have never made anything but blankets: plain, ridge, and check

claims.text: The cooperative counts just over two hundred members this year, most of them working from home looms.

citations.quote: the cooperative counts just over two hundred members this year, most of them working from home looms

claims.text: The cooperative's return for the current year reports about a hundred and fifty weavers on its rolls.

citations.quote: The cooperative's return for the current year reports about a hundred and fifty weavers on its rolls

claims.text: Asked about the size of the place this year, members put it at a couple of hundred of us, give or take.

citations.quote: Asked about the size of the place this year, members put it at a couple of hundred of us, give or take

claims.text: In 2015 its ridge-pattern blanket took the Fenmoor design award, the first time a cooperative rather than a mill had won it.

citations.quote: In 2015 its ridge-pattern blanket took the Fenmoor design award, the first time a cooperative rather than a mill had won it

claims.text: Awards recorded in members' filings include the Fenmoor design award.

citations.quote: Awards recorded in members' filings include the Fenmoor design award

claims.text: The Fenmoor design award, won in 2015, hangs framed in the entrance.

citations.quote: The Fenmoor design award, won in 2015, hangs framed in the entrance

claims.text: It has held the Fenmoor design award since 2015.

citations.quote: it has held the Fenmoor design award since 2015

claims.text: Halberd Mills Cooperative has opened a second dyehouse at its Cawden Vale site.

citations.quote: Halberd Mills Cooperative has opened a second dyehouse at its Cawden Vale site

claims.text: Members work their own hours on their own looms, and the cooperative employs no weavers directly.

citations.quote: It employs no weavers directly, since every member works to their own hours
Our members work their own hours on their own looms

claims.text: We have been in the same valley the whole time.

citations.quote: We have been in the same valley the whole time

claims.text: The cooperative still occupies the converted grain store in Cawden Vale.

citations.quote: in a converted grain store in Cawden Vale that it still occupies

claims.text: The Fenmoor award in 2015 changed how the shops treated us.
